title: Channelized model launch playbook and release-notes coordination
creator: Aisha Kapoor
description: Create a repeatable, channel-aware go-to-market playbook for adding new models to the Redwood catalog. This ticket coordinates release notes, benchmark publication, docs/SDK updates, marketing announcements, and cross-team readiness checks. The end goal is a checklist and templates that reduce launch friction and ensure consistent messaging across Console, API docs, blog, and partner channels.
checklist: Finalize model display name, short description, and tags for catalog page
Lock benchmark suite and report (latency, throughput, cost-per-token) with Research
Create release notes draft and one-line changelog for SDKs
Update API reference for new model alias and parameter defaults
Prepare console entry: model tile, docs link, and sample prompts
Coordinate launch date with infra/ops for capacity and scaling validation
Approve copy for blog post and support KB article
Prepare rollback/fallback plan and compatible model mapping
acceptance_criteria: Catalog page live in staging with correct metadata and samples
Benchmarks published with reproducible test harness and figures
Release notes approved and staged for publication on launch date
SDKs have example usage and version bump in CHANGELOG
Console shows model in the intended visibility state (preview/public)
On-call runbook updated with rollback steps and monitoring links
Launch comms scheduled across Slack, Docs, Blog, Twitter, and partner channels
communication_plan: T-minus 7 days: cross-functional readiness review in #prod-launch and send pre-brief to execs
T-minus 3 days: publish embargoed release notes to partners list and internal Notion folder
Launch day morning: push blog post at 09:00 PT, update docs site and SDK releases at 09:15 PT
Launch day: Slack announcement in #general, #customer-updates, and partner channels; Marketing will amplify on social at 10:00 PT
Post-launch 24–72h: monitor metrics, support queue, and open follow-up items in this ticket
release_notes_outline: Headline: short benefit statement (what teams can do now)
Summary: what the model is optimized for, recommended use-cases
Benchmarks: latency/throughput highlights and test conditions
Migration notes: breaking changes or alias mappings
Examples: 2–3 quick code snippets for common SDKs
Limits & pricing: default token limits and any pilot pricing
How to get started: links to console, docs, and support
rollout_schedule: 2026-03-25: Internal staging release for engineering and Docs review
2026-04-01: Public catalog launch and documentation publication
2026-04-01 to 2026-04-07: Gradual traffic ramp with monitoring gates
risks_and_mitigation: Risk: Benchmarks not reproducible on customer workloads - Mitigation: include test harness and sample data, label results with latency percentile and sequence lengths
Risk: Capacity shortage at launch - Mitigation: pre-allocate dedicated capacity for first 72 hours and configure autoscale thresholds
Risk: Confusing SDK behavior due to parameter defaults - Mitigation: add migration notes, bump SDK minor version, and include examples
Risk: Messaging mismatch across channels - Mitigation: single source of truth doc and sign-off gate for Marketing + Support
success_metrics: Adoption: number of unique API keys calling new model in first 30 days
Reliability: p99 latency within target for 95% of time during ramp
Support: zero critical tickets caused by model misconfiguration in first week
Business: traction in at least 3 pilot customers within 30 days
post_launch_tasks: Run 1-week retrospective and capture learnings in Confluence
Audit metrics and compare to published benchmarks; publish any deviations
Iterate on release notes based on customer feedback
Create follow-up tasks for SDK optimization or example expansion
Schedule a 30-day check-in with Sales and Customer Success
notes: This playbook should be used as a template for future model additions. Keep language vendor-neutral and include a short 'when not to use' section in docs for safety/edge cases. If any legal/compliance concerns appear, loop in Legal immediately and pause public comms.
